items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: She gave a dance at the Franz(?) Ami... 'Wilhelmina Breaux Presents the Original Boozaire(?) Kings.' ... When she got through, she gave us a dollar-and-a-half a piece.

ctx.x: Yeah. Same gangs as Chicago(?). So Wilhelmina Breaux(?) was a piano player, and she heard about everything in the whole Downtown, in this section where we had a (?) section, an eight-block section was the Boozaire(?) Kings.
